Some of the biggest brands like Shopify, Instacart, and Airbnb are using AI marketing tools internally to gain a competitive edge. Through my network and my time running content marketing at Webflow, I’ve uncovered some of the best AI marketing tools on the market today (and listed them below).

It's pretty obvious that AI tools have taken not only marketer by storm, but the tech industry in general.

Is it all hype?

Will we see a bubble burst like we did 26 years ago?

It's tough to tell. But one thing I'm certain about — AI marketing is the future for how we connect with our target audiences.

While AI today is simply just complex machine learning, the future of AI marketing software is bright.

I've been constantly testing and using different AI tools in my marketing stack for the past 3 years, and every once in a while I come back to this article to update it with any new tools I find myself using often.

If you look at some other posts on this subject, they've been totally copying me and trying to feed you a bunch of results influenced by sponsorhsups.

But this post is different.

These are the best AI tools I ACTUALLY use (and none are sponsored). And if you watch my YouTube video below, you'll see the ones I use the most (and how). The last one in the video is the one I use the most.

Alright, let's go over some of my favorite tools and how I think AI can be applied to different areas of your marketing stack.

## What is AI used for in marketing?

In 2026, marketing is all about having the right data, giving AI instructions on how to interpret that data, and creating AI agents that can help you execute based on the first two. This data can be first-party analytics, third-party data sources, information on your competitors, on [market trends](https://www.marketermilk.com/blog/marketing-trends), and on what your customers (and potential customers) are saying about your product. There’s a lot of information out there but it’s hard to manually source.

Now, AI search engines like Perplexity or Google's AI Mode make this process much simpler. And then, we combine this with agents and all the sudden we have a new wave of productivity tools that coulnd't exist before.

Here are some ways my friends and clients are [using AI in marketing](https://www.marketermilk.com/blog/ai-marketing-workflow):

*   Sentiment analysis on social media to aggregate positive and critical product reviews with tools like Gumloop.
*   Automating competitor intelligence reports to stay up to date with what rival brands are doing. You can improve the ROI of your marketing campaigns with better targeting.
*   AI workflows to write creative copy, helping you keep up with the internet’s incessant demand for content ([SEO optimization](https://www.marketermilk.com/blog/best-seo-automation-tools)).
*   Video editing and content creation workflows with tools like Midjourney and Crayo.
*   Automating and presenting report with things like Claude Artifacts.
*   Ad creation automation with tools like Arcads.

And a ton more we'll get into in this article.

It’s likely that you’ll use more than one AI-powered software solution. In fact, most data manipulation tools now use the power of machine-learning and automation to achieve impressive results at scale. In this rundown of some of the best AI-driven apps and platforms, I’ll explain exactly what each one does, what its benefits are, as well as any limitations it might have.

Prefer to watch my top favorite tools? Check out my video:

For those that like to read, keep scrolling.

## What are AI marketing tools?

AI marketing tools are software platforms that integrate with LLMs and your existing marketing workflows, using MCP (Model Context Protocol), to help automate internal workflows for marketers. These tools can help you either create something new, using AI, or take your automation skills to the next level without needing to be an AI Engineer.

At first, many of these AI tools seemed to just be using regular machine learning algorithms that had nothing to do with modern day "AI". But now, many of them leverage large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Grok, to give your existing workflows a layer of intelligence we have never seen before. It's actually quite amazing.

There's now this wave of new AI tools and marketing automation platforms that are changing the way teams think about productivity. Even Tobi, CEO of Shopify, [sent a memo](https://www.forbes.com/sites/douglaslaney/2025/04/09/selling-ai-strategy-to-employees-shopify-ceos-manifesto/) saying that all employees need leverage AI tools in some way. So it's no longer something we can turn a blind eye too (even though I did for some time).

Okay, let's check out the tools!

AI in Marketing Automation

# Artificial intelligence in marketing automation

Learn how to leverage AI in Marketing Automation to analyze, predict, strategize, launch smarter campaigns, and generate more meaningful engagement. Use AI-driven marketing automation tools to predict customer behavior accurately, decode individual intent, and engage at precisely the right times to maximize impact with the AI driven marketing automation tool. Make every interaction feel more personal, purposeful, and human.  

[Start your free trial](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/signup.html)

AI explained0%

What is AI in marketing automation?

Why should businesses invest in an AI-powered marketing automation tool?

How to implement AI in marketing automation tool?

What are some everyday AI use cases in a marketing automation tool?

Why you should choose Zoho for AI in marketing automation?

How is Zoho Marketing Automation priced?  

Befriend AI with Zoho Marketing Automation

## What is AI in marketing automation?

At its core, [artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.gartner.com/en/information-technology/glossary/artificial-intelligence "artificial intelligence (AI)") applies advanced analysis and logic-based techniques—including machine learning—to interpret events, support and automate decisions, and take actions.

[Marketing automation](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/what-is-marketing-automation.html) is a toolset that helps businesses streamline, automate, and measure repetitive marketing tasks so they can move away from manual task management and toward data-driven efficiency.

When AI and marketing automation come together, the result is a powerful shift from reactive execution to predictive analytics in marketing.

While traditional marketing automation executes workflows based on predefined "if-then" rules, AI-powered automation adds an intelligent layer to every stage of a campaign. It doesn't just follow instructions; it helps craft impactful content, analyzes customer behavior in real time, and identifies the optimal moments to engage with each individual.

## Why should businesses invest in an AI-powered marketing automation tool?

The primary reason to invest in AI-powered marketing automation is to turn a basic task executor into a strategic assistant. By automating the heavy lifting of content refinement and engagement timing, these tools help maximize performance and strengthen customer relationships—thereby enabling businesses to move beyond simple automation and drive higher ROI through smarter, data-backed execution.

Beyond that, AI bridges the gap between data and strategy by improving content quality and identifying the exact moments a customer is most likely to convert. With these capabilities, marketers ensure their work isn't just efficient, but consistently effective in a competitive market.

**Scaling personalization**

AI enables true one-to-one personalization by analyzing customer data, preferences, and behavior. It delivers tailored content, product recommendations, and messaging at an individual level, from email to [WhatsApp Marketing](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/multi-channel-marketing/whatsapp-marketing.html), to ensure every interaction feels uniquely curated.

**Predictive analytics in marketing**

AI analyzes past and real-time data to anticipate customer needs and determine the most effective moments to engage. By reaching customers when they're most likely to respond, businesses can act proactively rather than reactively.

**Intelligent campaign optimization**

AI continuously learns from performance data to refine messaging, targeting, and delivery across [multichannel marketing automation](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/multi-channel-marketing.html) campaigns. By constantly optimizing content and engagement timing, it ensures campaigns are more efficient and consistently improving over time.

## How to implement AI in marketing automation tool?

Implementing AI in your marketing eliminates data-heavy work, which in turn gives marketers time to focus on the strategy and storytelling efforts that actually move the needle.

Here's a roadmap for implementation and the high-impact areas of marketing automation, where AI creates the greatest impact.

**1\. Begin with clear objectives**

Start by defining exactly what you want from AI in marketing automation. This step is important because AI-powered marketing automation works best when it's tied to a specific business outcome. Instead of using AI broadly, identify clear goals, such as improving lead quality, increasing conversion rates, or saving time on [social media automation](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/multi-channel-marketing/social-media-marketing.html) and campaign execution.

**2\. Ensure your data is ready**

AI marketing automation tools depend heavily on data, so the quality of your data directly impacts the results you get. Before implementing AI, make sure your customer data is clean, organized, and accessible. This means removing duplicate records, updating outdated information, and bringing together data from different sources, like your CRM, website, and campaigns.

When your data is structured and reliable, machine learning models can generate more accurate insights and predictions—making your marketing automation strategy more effective. A seamless [CRM and Marketing Automation](https://www.zoho.com/marketingautomation/crm-ma-integration.html) integration ensures this data stays structured and accessible across both teams. High-quality data is the foundation of predictive analytics in marketing and personalized customer experiences.

**3\. Explore use cases**

Rather than trying to apply AI-driven marketing automation across all marketing activities at once, it's better to start with a few high-impact areas. These are typically areas where manual effort is high and improvement can be easily measured. For example, AI can analyze past engagement patterns to identify the optimal time to send a campaign and ensure your message reaches your audience when they're most likely to open and interact with it.

**4\. Pick a tool**

The success of your AI marketing automation implementation depends largely on the platform you choose. A good tool should not only automate tasks but provide intelligent insights that support better decision-making as well. It should integrate smoothly with your existing systems, be easy for your team to use, and offer clear reporting. Choosing the right AI-powered marketing automation platform helps reduce complexity and enables faster adoption of AI across your marketing efforts.

## What are some everyday AI use cases in a marketing automation tool?

**Faster campaign creation with AI-assisted content**

A marketing team who's preparing to launch a campaign will need landing page copy, but wants to avoid spending too much time starting from scratch. An AI content assistant can generate goal-focused landin
